literal: Difficulty it possesses, saying, not losing heart is needed; greatness, effort will give.
translation: One should not lose heart thinking a task is too difficult. Effort will grant the greatness needed to achieve it.
modern: ஒரு செயல் செய்வதற்கு கடினமானது என்று எண்ணி மனம் தளராமல் இருக்க வேண்டும். அதைச் செய்து முடிக்கும் பெருமையை ஒருவரது முயற்சியே தந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet advises against giving up on a task just because it seems too difficult to accomplish. The word 'அசாவாமை' means not growing weary or losing heart when facing a challenge. Instead of feeling inadequate, one must realize that 'முயற்சி' (effort) itself will provide the 'பெருமை' (greatness or capability) required to succeed. The focus is on action and perseverance rather than the initial difficulty of the goal.
